findings.label: clipboard-win contract not source-verified
findings.detail: The 'set_bitmap expects a full BMP file including the BITMAPFILEHEADER' claim rests on the crate's documented behaviour and the code/test, not a read of the clipboard-win 5.4.3 source (the Windows-only dependency is not vendored in the local cargo registry on this non-Windows host). It matches clipboard-win 5.x known behaviour and the deterministic test pins the layout; the owner's manual Windows paste is the end-to-end confirmation.
